_source: registry.d/wave1-flatpak.json — APP-CATALOG.md Wave 1 completion (communication, gaming & compatibility, emulation, media playback), staged 2026-08-19 for merge into registry.json under `apps`. Every entry is a Flathub recipe: no download_url, no checksum, nothing mirrored — policy 1 (filter Flathub, do not mirror).
_signing: UNSIGNED BY CONSTRUCTION. Every entry carries "signature": "". After merging, run `make sign-registry` then `make verify-registry-prod`. scripts/verify-app-recipe.sh REFUSES an unsigned entry (line 684), so no entry here can be install-tested by the harness until the founder's offline ceremony has signed it.
_verified_by: Flathub API v2 (summary + appstream + verification/status) fetched 2026-08-19, PLUS scripts/verify-flatpak-candidates.sh --file registry.d/wave1-flatpak.json, which resolves every id through a real `flatpak remote-info flathub --arch=<arch>` in a debian:trixie container for each declared architecture. That proves the id exists, is unambiguous under the argv FlatpakInstall runs, and resolves for exactly the arches declared. It does NOT prove the app launches or renders — that is scripts/verify-app-recipe.sh's job and it cannot run before signing.
_permissions_model: The `permissions` array is what the app NEEDS in Vulos's model, curated per app, NOT a dump of the Flatpak sandbox. Flathub grants devices=[all] to almost everything, which would make "gpu" and "camera" universal and meaningless. Each entry's _note records the measured Flatpak sandbox verbatim so the two models can be compared. ENFORCED FROM 2026-08-19: backend/services/appnet/flatpak_permissions.go narrows an installed Flatpak to what its recipe declares — undeclared network becomes --unshare=network, undeclared filesystem becomes --nofilesystem=host --nofilesystem=home. So these arrays are no longer documentation and every one of them was re-checked against what the app actually needs.
_excluded: From this wave, with the measurement that decided it: com.discordapp.Discord, com.slack.Slack, us.zoom.Zoom, com.spotify.Client, com.valvesoftware.Steam and org.vinegarhq.Sober — all LicenseRef-proprietary in Flathub AppStream, excluded by APP-CATALOG policy 1a. org.duckstation.DuckStation and com.github.iwalton3.jellyfin-media-player — Flathub reports is_eol=TRUE for both, so they are dead ids, not policy exclusions.
